33.name: First Light
33.why: Dawn light on an empty stage, moving before the music has even started.

33.name: Morning Haze
33.why: A soft haze over the studio floor, and the line of every arm still reads through it.

33.name: Pointe Shoe
33.why: Every studio I worked in had these pink satin shoes, lifting a dancer's whole weight into one clean line.

34.name: Mountain Lake
34.why: Still water held at altitude, a long line with no wobble in it.

34.name: Evening Sea
34.why: The sea at dusk moves in unhurried phrases, paced like an adagio.

34.name: Kura River
34.why: The Kura runs fast through Tbilisi, and speed and pride are the Georgian in me.
